messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (authz incident last week). I sketched a compact tracker below — need owners and dates. TL;DR: permission-drift + audit gaps caused a missed token refresh window for three services. We need automation, alerting, and runbook updates.

maya: Adding a bit more context: root cause was the rotation job's namespace regex mismatch after the config cleanup. It skipped two namespaces for the rolling rotation window. PR 4321 fixes the regex, but we need end-to-end validation and a guard.

cj: I'll take rotation automation (RD-234). Plan: add idempotent rotation and a canary flow, plus CI e2e. Target end of sprint (Tue 2026-03-31).

sophie: I'll own audit logging and alerting (RD-235). I'll draft a Splunk query + dashboard and a pager rule. Draft by Fri 2026-03-27, deploy next week.

alex: Priority set: P1 rotation automation (RD-234), P2 alerts/dashboard (RD-235), P3 runbook/manual remediations (RD-236). Label tasks "permission-drift" and add to the incident board.

incident-bot: Created board and tickets: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/abc123  (RD-234, RD-235, RD-236).

maya: I'll own the runbook update and immediate manual rotations (RD-236). ETA Thu 2026-03-27 for runbook update. I'll perform manual rotations for the three affected tokens tonight and post logs here.

cj: Manual rotations completed for svc-payments and svc-billing. Logs: ```rotated svc-payments ok
rotated svc-billing ok
svc-logging failed -> permission path mismatch```

sophie: svc-logging failure looks like it still references the legacy keymaster path. I'll coordinate with infra to update the secret path mapping and open a PR.

alex: Also add a recurring audit job to flag tokens with TTL > 60 days and any manual-exempt flags. Sophie, please include that in RD-235.

sophie: Good call. Draft Splunk query (working): ```index=auth_logs sourcetype=token | where token_ttl_days > 60 | stats count by service, token_id | sort -count``` Will refine and add to dashboard.

cj: I'll add an e2e test to CI that simulates the config regex change and ensures the rotation job fails loudly (PR 4330). Also adding a simple metric the rotation job increments so we can alert on misses.

maya: Ownership summary: RD-234 (rotation automation) -> cj -> ETA 2026-03-31; RD-235 (alerts + dashboard + recurring audit) -> sophie -> draft 2026-03-27; RD-236 (runbook + manual rotation) -> maya -> 2026-03-27. If anyone needs to reassign ping here.

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll put an oncall note for next week's coverage and create the pager policy draft in the alerts repo.

alex: Reminder: incident postmortem link: https://redwood.link/pm-authz-2026. Quick sync Wed 2026-04-01 09:30 PT (15 min) to confirm progress. If no blockers, target closure by 2026-04-10.

cj: 04/01 09:30 PT works for me.

security-eng: FYI: I'm scheduling a short audit to look for other services with similar token paths and will share findings before the sync.

maya: Thanks — please add any discovered services to RD-234 as blockers.

alex: Great. I'll update the incident doc with these owners and close the loop after the sync. Thanks everyone.
